w8wp_discovery_label: Show in the list of public pages
w8wp_discovery_on: Website plugins, such as the WordPress banner, can find this page in the server's list of public pages.
w8wp_discovery_off: Not in the list of public pages. The page stays readable at its address.
w8wp_discovery_unpublished: Only published pages appear in the list of public pages.
w8wp_discovery_private: A private page never appears in the list of public pages.
